test_title: PYST 17: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 8 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be the result of the sum of 2 and the number appearing opposite to '2'. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/12117dbafb4aa24eeac7e2d4b8456a581998ead400195196665189882390e83e.png]
solution:
When a common digit is on the same face of the same dices, then the digits written after the common digit is opposite to each other .(in the same direction)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a47fc70873401021e280d6460b62116d019bfda93c25e0a587d6d977e1e6bf4a.png] 

Therefore, 1 is opposite to 6

 4 is opposite to 3

 2 is opposite to 5(left one)

So, the sum of 2 and 5 is** 7**

Hence, the correct answer is **option(2)**
